claim: A focus brief approaching the mint gate carries a mint manifest: a section enumerating the candidate beliefs the focus will plant, one typed row each (structural type, draft claim, deps, grounding artifact), with rows recording their belief id as they plant so a focus can mint some rows and remain live. Type commitment happens late, on manifest rows inside the brief, never early as typed nursery documents: typing documents by eventual DAG type fragments the focus, forces classification at minimum information, and grows a shadow graph. Action items in a brief are prescription rows in its manifest, minted to the desk when firm; no mutable document competes with the graph as todo tracker.

evidence.detail: Deliberated as the nursery focus beliefs/nursery/mint-manifest.md - the surviving weak form of the typed-nursery-documents proposal, which was rejected on four grounds (type is an output of deliberation, not an input; one focus mints several beliefs of several types, so typed docs fragment the focus; typed proto-beliefs want typed proto-relations and grow a shadow graph; attestations and aggregations are mechanical at mint time) - and planted from the brief's own manifest row, self-demonstrating. Preflight 2026-07-02 surfaced contract-level claim-overlap with cb:b052 and cb:b059 plus schema-level overlap with cb:b398 and cb:b399; adjudicated by the operator as topical overlap, not contradiction, per the b475/b067 review precedent: this prescription governs nursery brief structure (a markdown section), not DAG node field presence (b052) nor grounding rules (b059) - each prescription minted from a manifest row satisfies b059 individually, and this belief itself grounds document: in its brief. The cited commit landed the brief batch.
